Part II:
```{r}
communities <- read_html("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Community_areas_of_Chicago")
```
reads the page into r

```{r}
df_communities <- communities %>%
  html_element("table") %>%
  html_table%>%
  janitor::clean_names()
```
Calls the table from the datapage and uses the element function to scrape the table from the page into a neat table

```{r}
df_communities <- df_communities %>%
  slice(-(1), -(n()))

df_communities <- df_communities %>%
  rename(
    area_sqmi = area_9,
    area_km = area_9_2,
    density_sqmi = density,
    density_km = density_2
  )

df_communities <- df_communities[, -1]

df_communities$population <- gsub("[,]","", df_communities$population)
df_communities$population <-as.numeric(df_communities$population)
```
Cleaning the dataframe by cleaning the column names and removing the numbering column, removing additional rows and removing the commas from population and changing population data type to numeric
